lines.text: Zephaniah says woe to the rebellious city of oppressors, which heeded no voice and accepted no correction.
Her princes are roaring lions, and her judges are bears at evening, leaving nothing for the morning.
Her prophets are reckless, faithless men, and her priests profane the sanctuary and do violence to the law.
The LORD within her is righteous and applies His justice every evening, yet the unjust know no shame.
The LORD will gather nations and pour out His anger, and all the earth will be consumed by the fire of His jealousy.
